# FileDock 1.30.4
- 修复完整文件名提示触发后仍不可见的问题：原生窗口安装内容视图时会把视图重设为窗口当前大小，原先因此丢失了测量结果，形成 0×0 的提示窗口；现在保留并明确应用测量出的宽高。 - 通过单个窗口级本地鼠标事件监听，把悬停路由到可见的文件名区域，避免 SwiftUI 透明拖动层下的文字跟踪回调丢失。事件原样继续分发，不接管点击或拖放。 - 悬停文件图标、文字或项目内留白均可查看完整名称。仅截断的名称显示提示；完整显示的名称不提示。保留鼠标跟随、屏幕边缘避让，以及移开、点击、拖动、滚动和编辑时收起。 - 共用一个提示窗口，缓存截断测量，不新增轮询或文件读取；空闲移动不重复创建取消令牌。 - 增加首次创建／重复使用浮层的真实尺寸测试，以及三种视图中窗口移动事件、短名称排除和重命名回归检查。
## English
- Fixes filename tooltips being triggered but remaining invisible. Installing a content view resizes it to the panel's current size; this previously erased the measured dimensions and left a 0×0 popup. The measured size is now retained and applied explicitly. - A single app-local window event monitor routes pointer movement to visible filename regions, avoiding missing text tracking callbacks beneath SwiftUI drag overlays. Events continue unchanged; clicks and drops retain their normal handling. - Hovering over a file icon, its label, or cell padding reveals the complete name when its label is truncated. Fully visible names show no tooltip. Pointer-following placement, screen-edge clamping, and dismissal on leaving, clicking, dragging, scrolling, or editing are preserved. - Reuses one popup and caches text measurements without polling or file reads. Idle pointer movement avoids repeatedly creating cancellation tokens. - Adds regression checks for actual popup dimensions on creation and reuse, plus window-event routing, fitting-name exclusion, and renaming in all three file layouts.
Requires macOS 13 or later. Universal build for Apple Silicon and Intel. Signed, not yet notarized by Apple. Existing settings and workspaces are preserved.
